name: Docker storage details
command: R=/Users/mekari/Library/Containers/com.docker.docker/Data; echo DockerData; du -x -k -d4 "$R" 2>&1 | sort -nr | head -80; echo VM-files; find "$R" -type f -name '*.raw' -exec stat -f '%z %b %N' {} \; 2>&1; echo Fonts; du -x -k -d2 /Users/mekari/Library/Fonts 2>&1 | sort -nr | head -30; echo Logs; du -x -k -d2 /Users/mekari/Library/Logs 2>&1 | sort -nr | head -30; echo SDKs; for p in /Users/mekari/Library/Developer /Users/mekari/Library/Android; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then du -x -k -d3 "$p" 2>&1 | sort -nr | head -50; else echo ABSENT:$p; fi; done; echo iOS-backups; if [ -e /Users/mekari/Library/Application\ Support/MobileSync/Backup ]; then du -x -k -d2 /Users/mekari/Library/Application\ Support/MobileSync/Backup 2>&1 | sort -nr | head -30; else echo absent; fi
